That night, as the beam swept the dark water, he imagined a boy on some distant shore, long grown and gone, watching the same light turn.", "w02": "凌晨四点，城市还没醒。路灯把空荡的街道照成一条条昏黄的河，偶尔有出租车驶过，轮胎压过积水，声音很轻。便利店的灯一直亮着，店员趴在柜台上打盹。远处的高楼只剩几扇窗还亮，不知是谁在加班，还是失眠。环卫工人推着车，扫帚划过地面，沙沙作响。早点铺的老板已经开始和面，蒸笼里冒出第一缕白气。天边仍是深蓝，但再过一会儿，这座城市就会重新喧闹起来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when something solves a problem by using a smaller version of the same problem.\n- Imagine a stack of boxes: to count them, you count the top one, then ask a friend to count the rest the same way.\n- It keeps going until there's only one box left, which is easy to count, and then all the answers add up."}
